name: Argent Collegia
summary: Network of licensed mage institutions; respected, regulated, and politically divided.

name: Church of the Sacred Compact
summary: The dominant religious institution governing souls, marriages, burials, feast days, oaths, legitimacy, and community standing.

name: Crown of Valedorn
summary: Feudal heartland faction representing the queen, royal courts, high nobility, and lawful state authority.

name: Gilded Charter
summary: Merchant bloc controlling caravans, ships, letters, guards, credit, and infrastructure.

name: House of Ash
summary: Experts in burial failure, dangerous death, plague handling, and corpse contamination.

name: Lantern Synod
summary: Hardline Church faction devoted to Orun, purity, vigilance, magical restraint, false miracles, and dangerous sanctity.

name: Order of the Black Briar
summary: Female-only knightly-monastic monster-hunting and containment order stationed in spiritually unstable regions.

name: Royal Host of Valedorn
summary: The military face of the Crown: levies, sworn knights, household men-at-arms, and disciplined royal forces.

name: Thorn Kin
summary: Loose category of people and bloodlines entangled with wilderness powers; protectors, predators, shrine families, and old pact lineages.
